title: Overcoming the Obstacles
coreMove: Use one small, believable repair to return attention, ease, or goodwill after a charisma break.
sourcePressure: This chapter follows diagnosis with operational repair, keeping recovery practical and partial rather than magical.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: The weak version promises instant calm or perfect confidence. The useful version teaches small recovery moves that keep the interaction alive.

counterintuition: The obstacle is not the problem

exampleSpecs.domain: a fire-alarm inspection where an inspector has snapped at a building superintendent
exampleSpecs.audience: a rule-bound professional who needs repair without losing authority
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the superintendent cooperates before the failed panel is documented
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the inspector stops mid-form, names the specific panel fault again in a lower voice, and gives the superintendent one useful next action
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a red alarm panel blinking above an open inspection binder

exampleSpecs.domain: a wholesale bakery call where an owner hears herself becoming defensive about late deliveries
exampleSpecs.audience: a founder whose pride interrupts warmth
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether a grocer renews the pastry contract
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she stops explaining the driver shortage, repeats the grocer's date concern, and offers a smaller verified delivery window
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a flour-dusted invoice beside a ringing wall phone

exampleSpecs.domain: a radio producer booth after a guest freezes on air
exampleSpecs.audience: a behind-the-scenes leader who must restore another person's presence
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the interview recovers before the live segment collapses
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the producer chooses a calm handwritten cue on the studio glass instead of flooding the guest's headset with instructions
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a grease pencil note pressed against studio glass

exampleSpecs.domain: a glassblowing workshop where an instructor's correction has embarrassed a beginner
exampleSpecs.audience: a craft teacher who needs to repair warmth without lowering standards
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the beginner keeps the pipe steady enough to finish safely
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the instructor steps beside rather than behind him, points to the molten gather, and gives one physical correction he can do immediately
exampleSpecs.firstImage: an orange gather glowing at the end of a steel blowpipe

exampleSpecs.domain: a library reference desk where a librarian realizes she has made a patron feel foolish
exampleSpecs.audience: a knowledgeable reader whose expertise can bruise presence
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the patron admits the actual search need
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she rewinds from the jargon answer, turns the monitor so they can look together, and asks which result looks closest
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a catalog screen open beside a paper call-number slip

exampleSpecs.domain: a freight customs inspection where an agent must repair a hostile start with a driver
exampleSpecs.audience: a procedural professional whose power can feel punitive
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the driver follows the seal-check sequence without escalating
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the agent notes that repeating the rule louder failed, then resets by showing the seal number and inviting the driver to verify it with him
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a numbered cargo seal hanging from a blue trailer latch

skillTargets: choose a repair matched to the obstacle already identified
evaluate whether a reset returns attention to the other person

tryThisNowSpec: When you hear your tone go flat today, stop before the next sentence, repeat the other person's concrete concern, and give one next move.
